description: This source file implements the functions for replying with various HTTP status codes in a web server context. It includes functions to handle construction of HTTP response messages for different status codes such as 300, 301, 302, etc., and a central function WebRooReplyReq that dispatches to the appropriate reply function based on the status code.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooReplyReq(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,ULONG ulStatusCode,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a reply message with the specified HTTP status code, setting the reason phrase and the response info, then dispatches to specific reply functions based on the status code.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooReply300(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles HTTP 300 (Multiple Choices) response, optionally adding a Location header for redirection.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooReply301(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles HTTP 301 (Moved Permanently) response, optionally adding a Location header.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooReply302(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
